answer: Joining needs a bond that doubles for every live identity whose funding traces back to the same source within six hops. Validators walk this funding vine on-chain at registration, so a farm paying from one treasury posts 1, 2, 4, 8 units. Scattering cash through a nebula of fresh wallets only adds fees and delay, and any later merge exposes the shared root. Bonds of an exposed cluster drop into a canyon pool that pays the validators who traced it.
